sources: Nummenmaa, Suvilehto, Glerean, Santtila & Hietanen (2016), Topography of Human Erogenous Zones, Archives of Sexual Behavior 45(5), 1207–1216 – 704 Finnish volunteers (528 women, 176 men) colored body outlines; genitals strongest, then breasts/nipples, inner thighs, buttocks, mouth; men and women rated each other's maps similarly (mean r ≈ 0.78–0.79; partner-sex maps r ≈ 0.91–0.95); women's erogenous area during partner sex about 26 % of the body vs 22 % for men.
